items.name: Mediterranean Chickpea Spinach Pot
steps: Rinse the cooked chickpeas and prepare the chopped spinach and chopped tomatoes.
Warm the olive oil, bloom the cumin, and cook the vegetables until they begin to soften.
Add the beans and dried oregano; turn everything through the seasoned oil.
Pour in the water, add rock salt, and simmer until the flavors combine and the beans are very tender.
Mash a small portion to thicken the sauce naturally, then serve warm.
items.guidance: Mediterranean Chickpea Spinach Pot is a thoroughly cooked bean main with a moist sauce. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.

items.name: Bulgur Tomato Herb Pilaf
steps: Rinse the dry bulgur until the draining water is mostly clear; soak for 15 minutes and drain.
Warm the Olive oil in a heavy pot and bloom the cumin.
Add the diced tomato, fresh parsley, fresh mint and drained grain; stir for one minute.
Pour in the water and add the rock salt; cover and cook on low heat until the grain is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Rest off the heat for eight minutes, then lift the grains gently and serve warm.

items.name: Herbed Zucchini Chickpea Bake
